flow_title: Old posting check for negative amounts
flow_summary: An old routine receives an amount and writes the text "neg" to the console when the amount is below zero. It changes no amount, saves nothing and returns nothing. No other code in this module calls it.
starts_when: Never in this module: no other code calls it.
outputs: None. A console message "neg" is written when the amount is below zero.
flow_questions_for_sme: Is the old posting routine still used, and what should happen to a negative amount?

flow_steps.text: Write "neg" to the console if amount is below zero

scenarios.title: Negative amount is received
scenarios.outcome: The text "neg" is written to the console. Nothing else changes.

steps: The text "neg" is written to the console
example.result: No amount is changed or returned

no_business_rule.reason: Technical: only decides whether to write "neg" to the console. No amount, status or record changes.

glossary.business_meaning: Old routine that reports a negative amount on the console; its name suggests posting, but it posts nothing
